objective: Preallocate RBAC GRANT and REVOKE privilege vectors from the known comma-delimited privilege count.

tasks.title: Preallocate RBAC privilege lists
tasks.result: GRANT and REVOKE privilege parsing now preallocates the uppercase privilege vector from the comma count before pushing parsed privileges.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was full.
The change preserves split, trim, uppercase, GRANT, and REVOKE behavior while avoiding implicit privilege vector growth.
